A city known for its food. Two chefs determined to show it their way.
FilterCopy Candid and Hong Kong Tourism Board present Hungry In Hong Kong
The first episode of Hungry in Hong Kong kicks off the challenge as chefs Saransh Goila and Natasha Gandhi take travel creators Rashmee & Anant (SeaRats) through Central, with each revealing a completely different side of the same city.
From a fast, no-frills Cha Chaan Teng breakfast to a slow, precise matcha experience at Aokomi. From the 1930s old-school legacy at Luk Yu Tea House to the Michelin-starred refinement of Man Wah.
